doc.brief: `GtkFileChooser` is an interface that can be implemented by file selection widgets.
doc.md:
`GtkFileChooser` is an interface that can be implemented by file
selection widgets.

In GTK, the main objects that implement this interface are
[`FileChooserWidget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooserWidget) and [`FileChooserDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooserDialog).

You do not need to write an object that implements the `GtkFileChooser`
interface unless you are trying to adapt an existing file selector to
expose a standard programming interface.

`GtkFileChooser` allows for shortcuts to various places in the filesystem.
In the default implementation these are displayed in the left pane. It
may be a bit confusing at first that these shortcuts come from various
sources and in various flavours, so lets explain the terminology here:

- Bookmarks: are created by the user, by dragging folders from the
  right pane to the left pane, or by using the “Add”. Bookmarks
  can be renamed and deleted by the user.

- Shortcuts: can be provided by the application. For example, a Paint
  program may want to add a shortcut for a Clipart folder. Shortcuts
  cannot be modified by the user.

- Volumes: are provided by the underlying filesystem abstraction. They are
  the “roots” of the filesystem.

# File Names and Encodings

When the user is finished selecting files in a `GtkFileChooser`, your
program can get the selected filenames as `GFile`s.

# Adding options

You can add extra widgets to a file chooser to provide options
that are not present in the default design, by using
[`FileChooser.add_choice()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooser#method:add_choice). Each choice has an identifier and
a user visible label; additionally, each choice can have multiple
options. If a choice has no option, it will be rendered as a
check button with the given label; if a choice has options, it will
be rendered as a combo box.

add_choice.brief: Adds a 'choice' to the file chooser.
add_choice.md:
Adds a 'choice' to the file chooser.

This is typically implemented as a combobox or, for boolean choices,
as a checkbutton. You can select a value using
[`FileChooser.set_choice()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooser#method:set_choice) before the dialog is shown,
and you can obtain the user-selected value in the
[`Dialog::response`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Dialog#event:response) signal handler using
[`FileChooser.get_choice()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooser#method:get_choice).

add_filter.brief: Adds `filter` to the list of filters that the user can select between.
add_filter.md:
Adds `filter` to the list of filters that the user can select between.

When a filter is selected, only files that are passed by that
filter are displayed.

Note that the `chooser` takes ownership of the filter if it is floating,
so you have to ref and sink it if you want to keep a reference.

add_shortcut_folder.brief: Adds a folder to be displayed with the shortcut folders in a file chooser.
add_shortcut_folder.md:
Adds a folder to be displayed with the shortcut folders
in a file chooser.

get_action.brief: Gets the type of operation that the file chooser is performing.
get_action.md: Gets the type of operation that the file chooser is performing.

get_choice.brief: Gets the currently selected option in the 'choice' with the given ID.
get_choice.md: Gets the currently selected option in the 'choice' with the given ID.

get_create_folders.brief: Gets whether file chooser will offer to create new folders.
get_create_folders.md: Gets whether file chooser will offer to create new folders.

get_current_folder.brief: Gets the current folder of `chooser` as `GFile`.
get_current_folder.md: Gets the current folder of `chooser` as `GFile`.

get_current_name.brief: Gets the current name in the file selector, as entered by the user.
get_current_name.md:
Gets the current name in the file selector, as entered by the user.

This is meant to be used in save dialogs, to get the currently typed
filename when the file itself does not exist yet.

get_file.brief: Gets the `GFile` for the currently selected file in the file selector.
get_file.md:
Gets the `GFile` for the currently selected file in
the file selector.

If multiple files are selected, one of the files will be
returned at random.

If the file chooser is in folder mode, this function returns
the selected folder.

get_files.brief: Lists all the selected files and subfolders in the current folder of `chooser` as `GFile`.
get_files.md:
Lists all the selected files and subfolders in the current folder
of `chooser` as `GFile`.

get_filters.brief: Gets the current set of user-selectable filters, as a list model.
get_filters.md:
Gets the current set of user-selectable filters, as a list model.

See [`FileChooser.add_filter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooser#method:add_filter) and
[`FileChooser.remove_filter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooser#method:remove_filter) for changing individual filters.

You should not modify the returned list model. Future changes to
`chooser` may or may not affect the returned model.

get_select_multiple.brief: Gets whether multiple files can be selected in the file chooser.
get_select_multiple.md:
Gets whether multiple files can be selected in the file
chooser.

get_shortcut_folders.brief: Queries the list of shortcut folders in the file chooser.
get_shortcut_folders.md:
Queries the list of shortcut folders in the file chooser.

You should not modify the returned list model. Future changes to
`chooser` may or may not affect the returned model.

remove_choice.brief: Removes a 'choice' that has been added with gtk_file_chooser_add_choice().
remove_choice.md: Removes a 'choice' that has been added with gtk_file_chooser_add_choice().

remove_filter.brief: Removes `filter` from the list of filters that the user can select between.
remove_filter.md: Removes `filter` from the list of filters that the user can select between.

remove_shortcut_folder.brief: Removes a folder from the shortcut folders in a file chooser.
remove_shortcut_folder.md: Removes a folder from the shortcut folders in a file chooser.

set_action.brief: Sets the type of operation that the chooser is performing.
set_action.md:
Sets the type of operation that the chooser is performing.

The user interface is adapted to suit the selected action.

For example, an option to create a new folder might be shown
if the action is %GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_SAVE but not if the
action is %GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_OPEN.

set_choice.brief: Selects an option in a 'choice' that has been added with gtk_file_chooser_add_choice().
set_choice.md:
Selects an option in a 'choice' that has been added with
gtk_file_chooser_add_choice().

For a boolean choice, the possible options are "true" and "false".

set_create_folders.brief: Sets whether file chooser will offer to create new folders.
set_create_folders.md:
Sets whether file chooser will offer to create new folders.

This is only relevant if the action is not set to be
%GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_OPEN.

set_current_folder.brief: Sets the current folder for `chooser` from a `GFile`.
set_current_folder.md: Sets the current folder for `chooser` from a `GFile`.

set_current_name.brief: Sets the current name in the file selector, as if entered by the user.
set_current_name.md:
Sets the current name in the file selector, as if entered
by the user.

Note that the name passed in here is a UTF-8 string rather
than a filename. This function is meant for such uses as a
suggested name in a “Save As...” dialog.  You can pass
“Untitled.doc” or a similarly suitable suggestion for the `name`.

If you want to preselect a particular existing file, you should
use [`FileChooser.set_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooser#method:set_file) instead.

Please see the documentation for those functions for an example
of using [`FileChooser.set_current_name()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileChooser#method:set_current_name) as well.

set_file.brief: Sets `file` as the current filename for the file chooser.

set_filter.md:
Sets the current filter.

Only the files that pass the filter will be displayed.
If the user-selectable list of filters is non-empty, then
the filter should be one of the filters in that list.

Setting the current filter when the list of filters is
empty is useful if you want to restrict the displayed
set of files without letting the user change it.

set_select_multiple.brief: Sets whether multiple files can be selected in the file chooser.
set_select_multiple.md:
Sets whether multiple files can be selected in the file chooser.

This is only relevant if the action is set to be
%GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_OPEN or
%GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_SELECT_FOLDER.

action.brief: The type of operation that the file chooser is performing.
action.md: The type of operation that the file chooser is performing.

create-folders.brief: Whether a file chooser not in %GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_OPEN mode will offer the user to create new folders.
create-folders.md:
Whether a file chooser not in %GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_OPEN mode
will offer the user to create new folders.

filter.brief: The current filter for selecting files that are displayed.
filter.md: The current filter for selecting files that are displayed.

filters.brief: A `GListModel` containing the filters that have been added with gtk_file_chooser_add_filter().
filters.md:
A `GListModel` containing the filters that have been
added with gtk_file_chooser_add_filter().

The returned object should not be modified. It may
or may not be updated for later changes.

select-multiple.brief: Whether to allow multiple files to be selected.
select-multiple.md: Whether to allow multiple files to be selected.

shortcut-folders.brief: A `GListModel` containing the shortcut folders that have been added with gtk_file_chooser_add_shortcut_folder().
shortcut-folders.md:
A `GListModel` containing the shortcut folders that have been
added with gtk_file_chooser_add_shortcut_folder().

The returned object should not be modified. It may
or may not be updated for later changes.
